---
title: "Indian Forest Cover Anomaly Dashboard"
output: flexdashboard::flex_dashboard
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
# Load processed data and models (adjust paths if needed)
forest_data <- read.csv("../data/processed/forest_data_processed.csv")
test_data <- read.csv("../data/processed/test_forest_with_anomalies.csv")
rf_model <- readRDS("../data/processed/rf_forest_model.rds")
# Calculate metrics
rf_pred <- predict(rf_model, test_data)
rmse_val <- round(RMSE(rf_pred, test_data$Forest_Area_sqkm), 2)
anomaly_rate <- round(mean(test_data$anomaly == "Anomaly"), 2)
